titre: Devoir de contrôle n°1 - Anglais (2ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
When Malala Yousafzai was a young girl in Pakistan, she loved going to school. But in her region, some people believed that girls should not be educated. Malala refused to stay silent. She began to speak publicly about the right of every girl to go to school. Because of her courage, she was attacked in 2012, but she survived and continued her fight even more strongly. In 2014, she became the youngest person ever to receive the Nobel Peace Prize. Today, Malala travels around the world, defending education for all children, especially girls. Her story shows that one determined voice can change the world.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What did Malala love doing when she was young?   (2 marks)
2) What did some people in her region believe?   (2 marks)
3) What important prize did she receive in 2014?   (2 marks)
4) What does Malala do today?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verbs in the past simple: She (begin) ______ to speak and (continue) ______ her fight.   (2 marks)
2) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): Malala is a girl ______ defends education for all.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (because / but): She was attacked, ______ she survived.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "young" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Write about a person you admire (real or famous) who fought for a good cause (about 8-10 lines). Say who they are, what they did and why you admire them. Use the past simple.
